# Security policy

This is the default security policy for Dustin-Dasal repositories that do not include their own `SECURITY.md`.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report security issues privately. Do not open a public GitHub issue for a suspected vulnerability.

- Email [ddasal@pm.me](mailto:ddasal@pm.me) and name the repository.
- On a public repository with private vulnerability reporting turned on, you can also use the **Report a vulnerability** button on that repository's Security advisories page.

Include what you found and, if you can, how to reproduce it. Please give the maintainer time to fix the issue before any public disclosure.
